messages:
Maya: Quick idea 9 launching a micro peer-recognition pilot next Wed at lunch. Digital badges + short Slack shoutouts + a small printed postcard option for onsite folks. Volunteers?
Samir: Love it. Whats the simplest scope?
Maya: Slash command only: /halo give @user <badge> <1-line reason>. No extra accounts.
Jess: I can wire the slash command and hook events to an internal topic. Will add rate limits (2/min, 10/day).
Samir: Please ensure analytics are anonymous by team, no free-text in metrics.
Jess: Will redact free-text from events; we'll send badge ID and length bucket only.
Katie: Ill draft the launch blurb + 1-pager and badge descriptions. Proposed badges: "Helps Often", "Problem Solver", "Culture Spark", "Ship-Minded", "Teacher".
Nora: For postcards  estimate 200 prints. Ops-bot, can you create a capture form for addresses?
Ops-bot: Form created: https://forms.redwood/humble-halo-postcards fields: giver, recipient, mailing address. Closes in 7 days.
Samir: Can we export counts by team for QBRs? Simple weekly counts would be great.
Jess: Events will be published to /events/humble-halo with payloads like {giver,receiver,badge,ts} (no PII).
Katie: Ill include KPIs in the 1-pager: reach, postcards sent, top badges. Also sample Slack copy.
Nora: I can handle printing & fulfillment if we get a ~$250 PO for 200 double-sided cards. Who approves?
Maya: Ill submit expense and tag finance.
Samir: Moderation volunteers for lunch? Keep it light.
Katie: I can moderate 11:30-12:30 PT Wed.
Jess: Deployment plan: staging Tue EOD, prod Wed morning. Ill post usage examples.
Maya: Calling this a "soft launch" so we can iterate. Quick sync Fri 9:00 AM PT to finalize copy, bot config, and PO. 20 min. Who's in?
Katie: In.
Jess: In.
Nora: In.
Samir: In.
Maya: Thanks all  Ill drop the 1-pager by Thu and send the invite. :sparkles:
